answer: Each agent may submit work, but the economy pays only after a result is accepted by a randomly assigned, stake-backed verifier, and that verifier loses stake if an appeal proves fraud. Repeating identities does not multiply influence: rewards follow verified output, while disputes can slash the bond. A sybil operator must fund many bonds and risk losing them on fabricated work; the shale ridge beside the river may host a hundred accounts, but it cannot make one false result pass verification.
